source_dataset.archive: Promoted Pass B v3 normalized ES/NQ OHLCV one-minute bars
source_dataset.timestamp: Exchange event-window bar close; historical receipt timestamp unavailable
source_dataset.roll_policy: No continuous-contract stitching; retain exact listed contract and use frozen Pass B active-window rollover metadata.
source_dataset.session_policy: Explicit archived exchange session IDs; never bridge session or contract boundaries.
source_dataset.gap_policy: No synthetic bars/fill/interpolation; exact 60s cadence only. Source reason SPARSE_NO_ELIGIBLE_TRADE_AGGREGATE is retained as ambiguous between no eligible trade and source omission.

feature_specification.required_sequence_identity: same session, exact listed contract, contiguous timestamps, all registered inputs non-null
feature_specification.normalization: Fit per-feature mean/population standard deviation using each unique eligible TRAIN feature row once, not once per overlapping sequence; zero standard deviation becomes 1e-12; apply unchanged to all later partitions.
feature_specification.missing_data: No imputation; machine-readable rejection reason; no future or counterpart forward-fill.

target_specification.invalid_policy: Invalidate target for incomplete cadence, session/contract boundary, missing observation, or invalid causal reference; never shorten or fill horizon.

architectures.A0_PREVIOUS_LABEL_PERSISTENCE: For each head/root/horizon, carry the latest label whose information interval ends no later than T; otherwise abstain.
architectures.A0_TRAIN_MAJORITY: TRAIN-only per root/head/horizon majority; lexical tie-break.
architectures.A0_TRAIN_TRANSITION_MATRIX: TRAIN-only first-order transition probabilities, Laplace alpha=1, prior label eligible only when its information interval ends by T.

A1_NUMPY_MULTIHEAD_MLP.loss: Unweighted sum of three categorical cross-entropies

A2_EXISTING_CAUSAL_TEMPORAL_CANDIDATE.implementation: Existing CausalTemporalConv.transform followed by same 8-unit three-head MLP
A2_EXISTING_CAUSAL_TEMPORAL_CANDIDATE.transform: Concatenate sequence mean, endpoint, and mean(x[:,1:])-mean(x[:,:-1]); output width 72 for 8x24 input.
A2_EXISTING_CAUSAL_TEMPORAL_CANDIDATE.known_architecture_discrepancy: Current transform is a fixed causal summary, not a learned temporal convolution; architecture review must explicitly resolve this discrepancy before approval.

architectures.multiclass_logistic_baseline: Excluded: existing logistic implementation is binary and not comparable to the frozen three-head task; adding a new candidate is outside this candidate set.

strongest_A0_selection: Select per root/head/horizon/window by validation categorical log loss ascending, then validation macro-F1 descending, then fixed lexical model ID ascending; freeze for test/OOS.

purge_embargo.rule: Require full label information interval end < next partition's first timestamp minus 30 elapsed minutes; no session/contract bridging.
purge_embargo.rule_embargo: Exclude first 30 elapsed minutes after each validation/test partition's first in-session timestamp from calibration/scored rows.

metrics.primary_aggregate: For each root/window, equal-weight arithmetic mean over the nine head x horizon cells; each cell is also reported and cannot be selected post hoc.
metrics.metric_conventions: Argmax ties choose lowest class index; zero denominator precision/recall=0; macro-F1 and balanced accuracy are equal class means; categorical log loss clips p below 1e-15; multiclass Brier=mean(sum_class((p-onehot)^2)/3); top-label ECE=sum_bin(n_bin/N*abs(bin_accuracy-bin_mean_max_probability)) with ten fixed bins [0,.1),...,[.9,1].

calibration.method: single scalar temperature scaling per root/head/horizon

uncertainty_abstention.seed_disagreement: Mean of all three pairwise Jensen-Shannon divergences across seed probability vectors, natural-log entropy divided by ln(2).
uncertainty_abstention.ranking: Ascending normalized entropy; ties by timestamp, instrument, then exact contract ID; retain full cutoff tie group and report realized coverage.

uncertainty_interval.interval: percentile 95%; resample full sessions within root/window
uncertainty_interval.pairing_and_p_value: Same session resample indices for candidate and comparator; directional delta positive means candidate better; two-sided add-one empirical sign p=min(1,2*min((1+n(delta<=0))/2001,(1+n(delta>=0))/2001)).
uncertainty_interval.minimum_support: At least 20 eligible session clusters per root/window and at least two distinct sessions containing each of the three target classes in every cell; otherwise inconclusive.

shuffled_label_control.permutation_unit: Within exact root/contract/session/horizon/head, permute labels across timestamps; independently permute heads; preserve each group's class counts.
shuffled_label_control.confirmatory_family: 96 tests = 3 shuffle seeds x 2 primary metrics x 2 neural candidates x 2 roots x 4 walk-forward test windows, using the same nine-cell aggregate and Holm family-wise alpha 0.05.
shuffled_label_control.stop_rule: If any shuffled-label comparison significantly beats the corresponding no-skill A0 comparator after Holm correction (p<0.05) and paired percentile 95% interval excludes zero, stop and investigate leakage.

acceptance_criteria.multiplicity: 32 confirmatory tests = 2 primary metrics x 2 neural candidates (ALL features) x 2 roots x 4 walk-forward windows; equal-weight nine-cell aggregate; Holm family-wise alpha 0.05; also require paired percentile 95% session-bootstrap interval to exclude zero in favorable direction.
acceptance_criteria.supported: For both ES and NQ, candidate improves both nine-cell aggregate primary metrics versus validation-selected strongest A0 with Holm-adjusted p<0.05 and paired percentile intervals excluding zero in >=3/4 walk-forward windows and all seeds; no class has zero predictions or zero recall in any cell; every head x horizon cell has favorable primary-metric point estimates in both roots; aggregate Brier/ECE point estimates are not worse than A0 in either root; shuffled-label control does not trigger stop.
acceptance_criteria.partially_supported: Only a precisely stated subset meets the same requirements; all contrary evidence is reported.
acceptance_criteria.inconclusive: Minimum eligible cluster/class support is not met, intervals span no difference, seeds/windows disagree with the frozen rule, or frozen analysis is incomplete.
acceptance_criteria.not_supported: Adequately powered comparisons show no primary improvement or consistent degradation.
acceptance_criteria.leakage_control_failure: Invalid experiment and stop, not evidence for or against the candidate.
acceptance_criteria.minimum_point_effect: None imposed; report effect sizes in native metric units and require corrected uncertainty, cross-seed/window/instrument consistency, calibration, and control checks.

manifest_hashing: SHA-256 canonical sorted compact JSON excluding manifest_sha256
